build_model_criterion: build a FairseqCriterion that relies on the model to supply and weight multiple loss terms
create_model_criterion_config: create a ModelCriterionConfig dataclass with loss_weights dict and log_keys list for criterion configuration
run_model_criterion_forward: run the ModelCriterion forward pass to compute scaled losses from model output and return aggregated loss
review_reduce_metrics: review the ModelCriterion reduce_metrics static method that aggregates logging outputs from data parallel training
test_logging_outputs_can_be_summed: test the ModelCriterion logging_outputs_can_be_summed method to verify distributed training optimization is enabled
